# Release notes

The release workflow uses `<tag>.md` from this folder as the body of the draft release, for example `v0.1.1.md`. If that file does not exist, it fills in `TEMPLATE.md` instead, replacing `${TAG}` with the tag name.

Notes are bilingual: the full English text comes first, then a `---` line, then a matching Chinese section. Keep both halves in step.

Tags below `v1.0.0` are published as pre-releases.
